ops.title: Correct 12.20.11 changelog: session-type key was not the (whole) root cause of the bootstrap EIO
ops.description: The 12.20.11 CHANGELOG (and the GitHub release notes) state that removing LimitLoadToSessionType from the two agents fixes the launchctl bootstrap EIO 5. Field evidence from the same day falsified key-presence as the standalone mechanism: on the local machine the identical keyless plist still EIOs through daemonkit's install spawn path while bootstrapping instantly from an interactive shell (daemonkit investigation 8841b9c0; leading candidate is the scrubbed spawn environment at daemonkit proc/manager.go:1143). The key removal remains correct and may genuinely fix the SSH/Background-key cell, but the causal claim overreaches. Correct the wording in the next release cycle once the investigation lands a root cause.

ops.text: CHANGELOG and release notes no longer attribute the EIO solely to LimitLoadToSessionType; they reference the caller-context investigation outcome
